constraints: The meaning of specifics depends on the value passed in type: for qr printer, specifics is "*" to suppress the print dialog; for qr HTML file / qr text file, specifics is the target file pathname (an empty string for qr text file triggers a Save file dialog).
Passing an empty string in specifics for qr text file output displays a Save file dialog instead of writing directly to a path.

For qr text file output, the default field/record delimiters are the FldDelimit/RecDelimit system variables (Tab / carriage return by default), which are shared with other commands such as IMPORT TEXT.
